comment:
* IkeLocalRequestScheduler caches all local requests scheduled by an IKE Session and notify the IKE * Session to process the request when it is allowed. * *

LocalRequestScheduler is running on the IkeSessionStateMachine thread.

variables.name: REQUEST_PRIORITY_URGENT
variables.comment: Local request that must be handled immediately. Ex: CMD_LOCAL_REQUEST_DELETE_IKE

variables.name: REQUEST_PRIORITY_UNKNOWN
variables.comment: Local request that has an unknown priority. This shouldn't happen in normal processing.

methods.name: public void addRequest(LocalRequest request)
methods.comment: Add a new local request to the queue.

methods.name: public boolean readyForNextProcedure()
methods.comment:
* Notifies the scheduler that the caller is ready for a new procedure * *

Synchronously triggers the call to onNewProcedureReady. * * @return whether or not a new procedure was scheduled.

methods.name: public void releaseAllLocalRequestWakeLocks()
methods.comment: Release WakeLocks of all LocalRequests in the queue
